baseline_policy: Freeze deployable compatible variants. A2 may be unavailable with evidence. Attribute new-engine value to the strongest valid existing variant per workload.

workloads.title: 导入、验证与基础事实
workloads.acceptance: 完整来源成员与逻辑DEX清单、拒绝/接纳记录、验证层证据；计入hash和必要解压
workloads.notes: Refine and freeze before measurement; no new-engine run exists in this package.

workloads.title: 精确类、方法、字段与字符串定位
workloads.acceptance: 固定NULL、重复、来源和完整小结果；不能只测第一条命中
workloads.notes: Refine and freeze before measurement; no new-engine run exists in this package.

workloads.title: 字符串组合、调用与字段引用
workloads.acceptance: 保留调用点、重复次数、动态调用种类和未知目标
workloads.notes: Refine and freeze before measurement; no new-engine run exists in this package.

workloads.title: HostLab SQL与复杂查询
workloads.acceptance: 冻结全部必要SQL模板及动态参数类别；严格比较NULL/CAST/LIKE/join/CTE/聚合/排序
workloads.notes: Refine and freeze before measurement; no new-engine run exists in this package.

workloads.title: 完整大结果生产和消费
workloads.acceptance: 短/长/偏斜字符串、1k/10k/100k及真实APK；相同完整DTO；计入编码/管道/解码/物化
workloads.notes: Refine and freeze before measurement; no new-engine run exists in this package.

workloads.title: Smali与可选高级分析
workloads.acceptance: 按已准入能力分层；M5所需反汇编必需；CFG/def-use单独后续资格
workloads.notes: Refine and freeze before measurement; no new-engine run exists in this package.

workloads.title: HostLab完整审计
workloads.acceptance: 两个固定APK的完整结构、surface、27FEATURE、门禁、指纹与跨版本报告；保留E/P/S/F/R/O实际边界
workloads.notes: Refine and freeze before measurement; no new-engine run exists in this package.

workloads.title: 持久缓存构建、重启和失效
workloads.acceptance: 首次构建、暖重开、损坏/失效重建分别计时；同证书；校验与修复成本入账
workloads.notes: Refine and freeze before measurement; no new-engine run exists in this package.

workloads.title: 同机1/2/4任务并发
workloads.acceptance: 固定公平总CPU/内存；统计吞吐、尾延迟、饥饿、取消和真实资源口径
workloads.notes: Refine and freeze before measurement; no new-engine run exists in this package.

workloads.title: 多版本增量和跨APK
workloads.acceptance: 全量B与增量B分别对照；计入hash、重绑和全局依赖更新；不得复用错误负结果
workloads.notes: Refine and freeze before measurement; no new-engine run exists in this package.

workloads.title: 资源与可选输入格式
workloads.acceptance: 逐项声明格式、配置与版本；unsupported不能从分母删除后声称全覆盖
workloads.notes: Refine and freeze before measurement; no new-engine run exists in this package.

workloads.title: 取消、预算、坏输入、坏缓存和故障
workloads.acceptance: 有界失败和明确完成/覆盖状态；expected_failure用例不进入速度成绩资格
workloads.notes: Refine and freeze before measurement; no new-engine run exists in this package.
